references.view: Indigo woodland, blue flowers and hard color clusters
Layers of blue rock; architecture omitted from the new backdrop

prompt: Create a distinct original 16:9 pixel-art side-scrolling RPG backdrop for a fictional sea cave in Inazuma between the previous dark woodland and a coastal overlook. First project art reference is for blue flora and stepped clusters only. Second project art reference is for layers of deep blue rock structure only; omit all ruins and buildings. A real enclosed coastal cave with a broad flattened natural arch, fractured aubergine rock wall and stalactites at upper edge, shallow still tidal pool mid-distance, indigo darkness on the left, a small bright irregular cave mouth in upper right with warm amber light and a glimpse of muted coral sky and sea. Add scarce tiny cool blue plants and a few soft warm shafts hitting the water. Dark quiet foreground from 70 percent down for the game-controlled reflective pools, enemies and feet; no lines that look like walkable platforms. Show no figures, lanterns, labels, roof architecture, signs, or UI. Authentic hard-edged grouped pixel colors, coherent limited palette. Landscape edge to edge.
scope: Original coastal cave backdrop for the lab. Existing project backgrounds were supplied as style and color references.
